1. Remove the mean of the image and multiply it by a 2D Hann window.
2. Take the FFT and the log magnitude L.
3. Find the local maxima of L that rise above the median of their ring by the threshold.
4. Keep the strongest, up to the most peaks.
5. Reject them with Gaussian notches on the spectrum of the image extended with the border mode.
